mapper.select: SELECT snapshot.snapshot_id FROM ai_business_snapshot snapshot WHERE snapshot.expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_business_snapshot child WHERE child.source_snapshot_id = snapshot.snapshot_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_composite_report_section section WHERE section.snapshot_id = snapshot.snapshot_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_project_panorama_snapshot_module panorama_module JOIN ai_project_panorama_snapshot panorama ON panorama.panorama_snapshot_id = panorama_module.panorama_snapshot_id WHERE panorama_module.snapshot_id = snapshot.snapshot_id AND panorama.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_business_snapshot_item artifact_item JOIN ai_result_artifact artifact ON artifact.id = artifact_item.result_artifact_id WHERE artifact_item.snapshot_id = snapshot.snapshot_id AND artifact.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ORDER BY snapshot.expires_at LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE
